ItemID: unavailable; Title: High Hopes; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Springsteen fits my interest in established rock musicians, but I would sample it before choosing it.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Endless River; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Pink Floyd's atmospheric rock interests me, though I want more song-focused listening right now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Morning Phase; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its mellow sound could suit my mood, but it is a less immediate choice than the roots-oriented records here.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Standing in the Breach; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Jackson Browne's thoughtful songwriting appeals to the side of my taste drawn to Benmont Tench.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Sonic Highways; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am less interested in hard-driving modern rock for this listening session.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Hypnotic Eye; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Enjoying Benmont Tench makes this Tom Petty and the Heartbreakers album a particularly appealing next listen.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Endless River; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: This appears to repeat an album already shown, and I have no reason to choose another listing.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Boys & Girls; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Assuming this is Alabama Shakes, the bluesy soul sound interests me, but I would preview it first.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Sigh No More; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its folk-oriented sound is less compelling to me right now than blues and classic rock.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: A Head Full of Dreams; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its bright pop direction is not what I am looking for in this session.
